name: Bootstrap DateTime Picker
description: DateTime picker form element using the Bootstrap datetimepicker library.
project_description:
Bootstrap DateTime picker module provides a widget for Drupal Date fields using the JQuery Date and Time Picker library by Eonasdan.

 About the 2.0.0 version 
 We strongly recommend using the 2.0.0 version because it is already Drupal 9 ready (8.8 or above ready too). The support for Drupal 8 will end on November, 2nd. Ref: Drupal 8 end-of-life on November 2, 2021 - PSA-2021-2021-06-29 

 If you already have any 8.x-1.x of this module installed, please read with attention the 2.0.0 release notes 

 INSTALLATION & USAGE 
 - See the README.txt file for the installation and usage documentation.

 FEATURES 
 - Widget works for both date and DateTime fields

- Supports Multilingual for both Date and Time pop-ups

- Responsive

- Supports 12 and 24-hour time formats

- You can specify granularity for minutes

- Disable dates for specific days

- Disable specific dates

- Min and Max date

- Integration with Webform as an element

- Supports Drupal 8, 9 and 10

 3.x 
 This branch is a major rewrite so that it works with version 6 of datetime picker 

This version won't work with the old version of the library

This version provides a webform element for DateTime 

 4.x 
 a Version compatible with Drupal 10 has been released.
